full_name: Dániel Péter Biró | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Dániel Péter Biró is an associate professor of composition and music theory at the University of Victoria, in Canada. He recently completed a commissioned composition for the Neue Vocalsolisten, premiered at the ECLAT Festival in Stuttgart, Germany, and coedited The String Quartets of Béla Bartók: Tradition and Legacy in Analytical Perspective (Oxford University Press, 2014).
